'''Trezya Nenei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] member of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our lovely friend here is from the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization. Her organization is looking to join the Rebellion on a more permanent basis.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium|Quellium]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
Trezya Nenei was a member of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]], a pro-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] organization during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she conducted business as a liaison with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium]] of the Rebel Alliance in his [[Wideband Temp Agency|office]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], on Talus.<ref name="SWG:RI" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization sought to join the Rebel Alliance on a permanent basis. In the meanwhile, both the A.C.L.O. and the Rebels were in conflict with the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a Talusian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire. At some point, N.S.H. troops shut down an A.C.L.O. clinic and imprisoned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer [[Syirlabradawk]], one of Trezya's friend. They also confiscated a shipment of medical supplies. Captain Quellium and Trezya Nenei therefore sent a spacer to raid the [[N.S.H. base]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> The spacer was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] who wanted to determine what kind of people the Rebellion and the Empire had chosen to work with.<ref name="SWG:CoA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Crisis of Allegiance|Talus}}</ref> The spacer assaulted the N.S.H. base and eventually managed to retrieve the medical shipment and rescue the medical officer, killing many N.S.H. enforcers in the process.<ref name="SWG:RI" /><ref name="SWG:MO" /> Trezya Nenei was very grateful to the spacer for saving her Wookiee friend.<ref name="SWG:RttR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to the Rebels|Talus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trezya Nenei was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Trezya Nenei was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
